Senses.Explanation: The equation of afflictions with awakening is explained through knowing and sharply restricted: Dahui rejects merely saying it before the matter has been penetrated. The equation reverses the usual opposition between afflictions and awakening, and Chan records both state that reversal and police its recitation. Yuan Cheng answers the direct question by rendering awakening as knowing and perceiving. He says confusion about awakening is called affliction, knowing affliction is awakening, and storing up that knowing is again called affliction. Dahui rebukes people who force the proposition while their conduct contradicts their talk and says only after breaking through may one say it. The Record of Ancient Venerables likewise records beginners claiming a uniform equalized view while their ordinary-and-holy and still-and-noisy distinctions remain twofold. The corpus presents an equation whose repetition masters openly challenge.
